name: OCG-120
description: Data record of the paper Schema-Linking at Scale: An Agentic Graph-RAG Pipeline for Cost-Efficient Text-to-SQL (submitted to Data & Knowledge Engineering, 2026). Contents: the OCG-120 Text-to-SQL benchmark (120 natural-language questions with gold SQL over a synthetic e-commerce warehouse with three nested schema tiers of 14, 24 and 32 tables); the database the experiments ran on (32 CSV files, 214,890 rows, with checksums); all run logs of the September 2026 campaign (39 files) and of its replication with gpt-5-mini, Claude Sonnet 5.5 and Gemini 2.5 Pro (24 files), each with per-question SQL, executed results, comparator verdicts, token counts, seeds and tool transcripts (the 34 logs of the superseded May–July 2026 campaign are kept for the record); the archived baseline prompts with SHA-256 hashes; the three knowledge graphs; the aggregation scripts with their outputs; and the full failure audit of the 206 Part 1A failures (five-vote LLM panel prompt, inputs, raw answers and votes, human adjudication, final taxonomy). The code (pipeline, evaluation harness, data generators) is maintained in the project repository, https://github.com/lvitose/ocg-text-to-sql. README.md is the map of the record and explains how to recompute the numbers of the paper.
